name: papertrail
description: PaperTrail — document intelligence platform on Zerops (7 services)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/worker ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/worker run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.dev:services: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:worker
